name: QUT Child Care Bursary
summary: A once-off payment to help QUT students who are parents or guardians cover childcare costs.
key: Valued at AU$500 per eligible child, paid as a once-off payment.
who: Australian or NZ citizens, permanent residents, permanent humanitarian visa holders, and international students.
Admitted and enrolled in an undergraduate, postgraduate or research degree.
Your child is currently attending an early childhood education and care service in Australia.
how: Include at least one document confirming your child's enrolment and attendance, such as a child care tax invoice or proof of Child Care Subsidy.
catches: Offered from Semester 2, 2026. The terms do not state the closing date.
Must meet QUT's scholarship, bursary and prize concurrency conditions.
